show_tray_icon.description: Whether to display the Peony tray icon in the system status area.

default_view_mode.description: The default view mode for directories. Common values: 'icon', 'list', 'compact'.

show_hidden_files.description: Whether to show hidden files (files starting with a dot) by default.

confirm_delete.description: Whether to prompt for confirmation before deleting files.

use_trash.description: Whether to move deleted files to the trash instead of permanently deleting them.

show_sidebar.description: Whether to show the sidebar with locations and bookmarks by default.

plugins.description: List of Peony plugin names to load. These should match the .so filenames in the plugins directory.
